articles.title: Snakes on a Train! King Cobras Might Be Riding the Rails in India
articles.summary: Imagine a 15-foot king cobra slithering onto a train! Researchers think these giant snakes are hitching rides across India, drawn by rats that eat leftover food. One rescuer-turned-scientist found evidence in Goa.

articles.title: A Tiny Chip That Could Help Self-Driving Cars See More
articles.summary: MIT scientists built a new lidar chip that lets self-driving cars see a wider area without moving parts. It uses tiny antennas that don't interfere with each other, making the view clearer and the sensor smaller.

articles.title: When Ferns Took Over the World and Set It on Fire
articles.summary: 201 million years ago, huge volcanoes warmed the Earth, trees died, and ferns spread everywhere. Scientists found that these ferns caught fire easily, turning ancient Europe into a wildfire nightmare. They discovered this by checking the color of fossil pollen.
